headline: No post-hoc variant improved on the frozen Baseline V1 ranking.

analyses.name: V2 Moving Discharge
analyses.description: Treats the slick as five along-axis segments released at different times, testing whether a moving discharge better explains the reconstructed source support.
analyses.verdictDetail: Ranked the documented possible-source vessel 147 of 610 on aggregate, against 22 for the frozen Baseline V1. Reported because it was pre-registered and run; not adopted.

analyses.name: FineAIS Diagnostic 8
analyses.description: Is coarse hourly 0.1 degree AIS resolution responsible for much of the remaining ranking ambiguity?
analyses.verdictDetail: Do not report rank 22 or any ordering from this eight-vessel subset as independent culprit-identification accuracy.

guardrail: These analyses are exploratory. The headline result reported anywhere in this application is the frozen blind Baseline V1 ranking, and no post-hoc ordering is presented as a baseline outcome.
